key_insight: MOTIF improves materials-property prediction under distribution shift by using LLMs to propose chemical taxonomies, rather than predict numerical properties directly.
engineering_relevance: More robust prediction for unfamiliar material families could support perovskite screening, with transferability also evaluated on 3D perovskite solar-cell efficiencies.
method: Generate candidate material taxonomies with LLMs.
Retain taxonomies that improve training-only pseudo-OOD validation.
Select invariant features within accepted taxonomies and combine predictions through gated aggregation.
evidence_signal: On 2D halide perovskites, mean OOD bandgap MAE fell from 0.122 to 0.111 eV; frozen dev/test evaluation also showed electronic and optical bandgap improvements.
watch_item: Benefits depend on taxonomy quality and validation design; the abstract does not quantify solar-cell efficiency gains.
paper_title: MOTIF: LLM-Defined Material Taxonomies for OOD Property Prediction via Invariant Feature Selection
